name: dacs-forge
description: Deterministic no-spend DACS service and conformance substrate for extension-only service implementations.

scripts.check: bun run verify:provenance && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.container:supply-chain: mkdir -p dist/container-supply-chain && docker build --pull --no-cache --provenance=mode=min --metadata-file dist/container-supply-chain/build-metadata.json --tag dacs-forge:supply-chain-candidate . && bun run ./scripts/container-supply-chain.ts qualify --image dacs-forge:supply-chain-candidate --output dist/container-supply-chain
scripts.verify:product-seal-candidate: bun run verify:public-export && bun run verify:release-manifest && bun run verify:migration-disposition && bun run verify:governance && bun run verify:provenance && bun run typecheck && bun test --timeout 10000 && bun run build && bun run mutation:calibrate && bun run verify:container
scripts.verify:product-seal-fork: bun run verify:release-manifest && bun run verify:migration-disposition && bun run verify:governance && bun run verify:provenance && bun run typecheck && bun test --timeout 10000 && bun run build && bun run mutation:calibrate && bun run verify:container
